column1: # Panel event gelombang 8 — Custom Procurement - Doll (varian "procurement"),
# dan panel rate dengan rincian rate-up per kategori.
# Varian ini memakai "Armament" dan "Redundant Fragments" (bukan Weapon /
# Redundant Pieces). Daftar nama Doll tidak berkutip di sumbernya — dibawa backref.
# Sumber punya satu tempat tanpa spasi sebelum "probability" — dicocokkan apa adanya.
# ============ Custom Procurement - Doll (varian procurement) ============
=Custom Procurement - Doll is a limited-time Doll procurement.
column2: Custom Procurement - Doll adalah procurement Doll waktu terbatas.

column1: ^<color=#f26c1c>\*During the event, the limited Elite Dolls (.+) can only be obtained through the \[Custom Procurement - Doll\] event\.$
column2: <color=#f26c1c>*Selama event, Elite Doll terbatas \1 hanya bisa didapat lewat event [Custom Procurement - Doll].

column1: ^After the event ends, the Elite Dolls (.+) will not be added to \[Standard Procurement\]\.</color>$
column2: Setelah event berakhir, Elite Doll \1 tidak akan ditambahkan ke [Standard Procurement].</color>

column1: =-Elite Doll Probability Description
column2: -Deskripsi Probabilitas Elite Doll

column1: =In this type of procurement, the base probability of obtaining an Elite Doll is <color=#EDA51C>[VAL1]</color>, and the overall probability (including the pity system guarantee) is <color=#EDA51C>[VAL2]</color>.
column2: Di tipe procurement ini, probabilitas dasar mendapat Elite Doll adalah <color=#EDA51C>[VAL1]</color>, dan probabilitas keseluruhan (termasuk jaminan sistem pity) adalah <color=#EDA51C>[VAL2]</color>.

column1: =In this type of procurement, the base probability for Standard Dolls and Armaments is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL3]</color>, the base probability for Standard Dolls is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL4]</color>, and the base probability for Standard Armaments is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL5]</color>.
column2: Di tipe procurement ini, probabilitas dasar Doll dan Armament standar adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL3]</color>, probabilitas dasar Standard Doll adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL4]</color>, dan probabilitas dasar Standard Armament adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL5]</color>.

column1: =The overall probability for Standard Dolls and Armaments (including the pity system guarantee) is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL6]</color>.
column2: Probabilitas keseluruhan Doll dan Armament standar (termasuk jaminan sistem pity) adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL6]</color>.

column1: =In this type of procurement, every 10 procurements guarantee at least a Standard Doll, Standard Armament, or Elite Doll.
column2: Di tipe procurement ini, tiap 10 procurement dijamin mendapat minimal Standard Doll, Standard Armament, atau Elite Doll.

column1: =In this type of procurement, if no Elite Doll is obtained for 58 consecutive attempts, the probability of obtaining an Elite Doll on subsequent attempts will increase.
column2: Di tipe procurement ini, kalau Elite Doll tidak didapat dalam 58 percobaan berturut-turut, probabilitas mendapatkannya pada percobaan berikutnya akan naik.

column1: =An Elite Doll is guaranteed within 80 procurements.
column2: Elite Doll dijamin didapat dalam 80 procurement.

column1: =Whenever an Elite Doll is obtained, the counter resets, and the probability of obtaining an Elite Doll returns to the base rate.
column2: Tiap kali Elite Doll didapat, hitungannya direset dan probabilitas mendapat Elite Doll kembali ke rate dasar.

column1: =If the Elite Doll obtained in this procurement is not the rate-up Elite Doll for this period, the next Elite Doll obtained is guaranteed to be the rate-up Elite Doll for this period.
column2: Kalau Elite Doll yang didapat di procurement ini bukan Elite Doll rate-up periode ini, Elite Doll berikutnya dipastikan yang rate-up periode ini.

column1: =Whenever a duplicate Doll is obtained through any means (including but not limited to procurement, exchange, events, etc.), it will be converted according to the following rules:
column2: Tiap kali Doll ganda didapat lewat cara apa pun (termasuk tapi tidak terbatas pada procurement, penukaran, event, dsb.), akan dikonversi menurut aturan berikut:

column1: =When a duplicate Standard Doll is obtained for the 2nd to 7th time, it will be converted into 30 Neural Archives of the corresponding Doll.
column2: Saat Standard Doll ganda didapat pada perolehan ke-2 sampai ke-7, akan dikonversi jadi 30 Neural Archives Doll terkait.

column1: =When a duplicate Elite Doll is obtained for the 2nd to 7th time, it will be converted into 30 Neural Archives of the corresponding Doll.
column2: Saat Elite Doll ganda didapat pada perolehan ke-2 sampai ke-7, akan dikonversi jadi 30 Neural Archives Doll terkait.

column1: =If obtained for the 8th time or more, it will be converted into 18 Redundant Fragments.
column2: Kalau didapat pada perolehan ke-8 atau lebih, akan dikonversi jadi 18 Redundant Fragments.

column1: =If obtained for the 8th time or more, it will be converted into 90 Redundant Fragments.
column2: Kalau didapat pada perolehan ke-8 atau lebih, akan dikonversi jadi 90 Redundant Fragments.

column1: # ============ rincian rate-up per kategori ============
=When obtaining an Elite Doll, there is a <color=#EDA51C>[VAL3]</color> probability that it will be the rate-up Doll and a <color=#EDA51C>[VAL4]</color>probability that it will be a non-rate up Doll.
column2: Saat mendapat Elite Doll, ada probabilitas <color=#EDA51C>[VAL3]</color> bahwa itu Doll rate-up dan <color=#EDA51C>[VAL4]</color>probabilitas bahwa itu Doll non-rate-up.

column1: =The probability of obtaining each non-rate up Doll is the same.
column2: Probabilitas mendapat tiap Doll non-rate-up adalah sama.

column1: =In this access type, the base probability of obtaining a Standard Doll or Weapon is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL5]</color>, with the base probability for Standard Dolls being <color=#AC65E8>[VAL6]</color> and for Standard Weapons being <color=#AC65E8>[VAL7]</color>.
column2: Di tipe access ini, probabilitas dasar mendapat Standard Doll atau Weapon adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL5]</color>, dengan probabilitas dasar Standard Doll <color=#AC65E8>[VAL6]</color> dan Standard Weapon <color=#AC65E8>[VAL7]</color>.

column1: =The overall probability (including guarantees) for both is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL8]</color>.
column2: Probabilitas keseluruhan (termasuk jaminan) untuk keduanya adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL8]</color>.

column1: =When obtaining a standard Doll or weapon, there is a <color=#AC65E8>[VAL9]</color> probability that it will be a rate-up standard Doll.
column2: Saat mendapat Doll atau senjata standar, ada probabilitas <color=#AC65E8>[VAL9]</color> bahwa itu Doll standar rate-up.

column1: =The probability of obtaining each rate-up standard Doll is the same.
column2: Probabilitas mendapat tiap Doll standar rate-up adalah sama.

column1: =There is a <color=#AC65E8>[VAL10]</color> probability of obtaining any non-rate up standard Dolls or weapons.
column2: Ada probabilitas <color=#AC65E8>[VAL10]</color> untuk mendapat Doll atau senjata standar non-rate-up mana pun.

column1: =The probability of obtaining each non-rate up standard Doll or weapon is the same.
column2: Probabilitas mendapat tiap Doll atau senjata standar non-rate-up adalah sama.

column1: =The base probability of obtaining a retired weapon is <color=#3191ab>[VAL11]</color>.
column2: Probabilitas dasar mendapat retired weapon adalah <color=#3191ab>[VAL11]</color>.

column1: =The combined probability of obtaining a retired weapon (including the guarantee) is <color=#3191ab>[VAL12]</color>.
column2: Probabilitas gabungan mendapat retired weapon (termasuk jaminan) adalah <color=#3191ab>[VAL12]</color>.

column1: =When obtaining a retired weapon, there is a <color=#3191ab>[VAL13]</color> probability that it is a rate-up retired weapon.
column2: Saat mendapat retired weapon, ada probabilitas <color=#3191ab>[VAL13]</color> bahwa itu retired weapon rate-up.

column1: =The probability of obtaining a non-rate up retired weapon is <color=#3191ab>[VAL14]</color>.
column2: Probabilitas mendapat retired weapon non-rate-up adalah <color=#3191ab>[VAL14]</color>.

column1: =The base probability of obtaining a Standard Doll is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL15]</color> (with a total combined probability of <color=#AC65E8>[VAL16]</color> after including the guarantee).
column2: Probabilitas dasar mendapat Standard Doll adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL15]</color> (dengan total probabilitas gabungan <color=#AC65E8>[VAL16]</color> setelah menghitung jaminan).

column1: =The base probability of obtaining a Standard Weapon is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL17]</color> (with a total combined probability of <color=#AC65E8>[VAL18]</color> after including the guarantee).
column2: Probabilitas dasar mendapat Standard Weapon adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL17]</color> (dengan total probabilitas gabungan <color=#AC65E8>[VAL18]</color> setelah menghitung jaminan).

column1: =The base probability of obtaining an Elite Doll is <color=#EDA51C>[VAL19]</color> (with a total combined probability of <color=#EDA51C>[VAL20]</color> after including the guarantee).
column2: Probabilitas dasar mendapat Elite Doll adalah <color=#EDA51C>[VAL19]</color> (dengan total probabilitas gabungan <color=#EDA51C>[VAL20]</color> setelah menghitung jaminan).

column1: =If no Elite Doll is obtained after 58 consecutive accesses, the probability of acquiring one will increase with each subsequent access.
column2: Kalau Elite Doll tidak didapat setelah 58 access berturut-turut, probabilitasnya naik tiap access berikutnya.

column1: =The probability increases by <color=#EDA51C>[VAL21]</color> for the next access and continues increasing by the same amount for every access thereafter, with a guarantee of obtaining an Elite Doll by the 80th access.
column2: Probabilitasnya naik <color=#EDA51C>[VAL21]</color> untuk access berikutnya dan terus naik dengan jumlah sama untuk tiap access setelahnya, dengan jaminan mendapat Elite Doll pada access ke-80.
